geoValidation.methodNote: Estimates are computed from geographic coordinates of destinations (straight-line distance × 1.3 for actual roads, 55 km/h average) — not real-time traffic data. Driving times are rounded.
geoValidation.levelsNote: {warn} warnings (demanding, but possible) and {error} critical warnings (not realistically doable).
geoValidation.methodNoteOsrm: Distances and drive times are ACTUAL ROAD values (OSRM / OpenStreetMap routing) between consecutive stops — not real-time traffic data. Times are rounded to 5 minutes.
geoValidation.methodNoteMixed: Distances and times are mostly actual road values (OSRM / OpenStreetMap); legs without road data are estimated (straight line × 1.3, 55 km/h). Not real-time traffic data.

about.title: About Discover Slovenia AI
about.intro: Discover Slovenia AI is an AI-powered travel platform connecting travellers with local providers across Slovenia. Our mission is to make discovering Slovenian destinations effortless — from Lake Bled to Piran — with artificial intelligence, an interactive map and direct links to local providers.

offerCards.plannerDesc: Generates personalised itineraries based on your budget, interests and season.
offerCards.destinationsDesc: From the Alps to the Adriatic — with an interactive map and thousands of POIs.
offerCards.providersDesc: Direct links to hotels, restaurants and activities — you always book with the provider, at no extra cost.
offerCards.languagesDesc: Slovene, English, German and Italian for global travellers.

about.howP1: The platform takes no commission on bookings. Instead, local providers pay a flat monthly subscription for their presence on the platform. Users always book directly with the provider — no middlemen.
about.howP2: The AI planner uses <sdk>z-ai-web-dev-sdk</sdk> to generate itineraries. Points of interest (POI) data comes from <osm>OpenStreetMap</osm> and <wiki>Wikipedia</wiki>. Weather data from <meteo>Open-Meteo</meteo>.
about.contactP: Questions? Write to <email>info@discoverslovenia.ai</email> or visit the <contactPage>contact page</contactPage>.

dataValues.tech: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Prisma, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui

romanticni-pobeg.q1: What makes {name} special for a romantic escape?
romanticni-pobeg.a1: {name} offers a unique blend of nature, cultural sights and cuisine. A romantic escape to {name} is perfect for anniversaries, Valentine's Day or proposals — the emphasis is on privacy, views and local flavours.
romanticni-pobeg.q2: How much does a romantic escape to {name} cost?
romanticni-pobeg.a2: A romantic escape to {name} typically costs {price}, including a room with a view, dinner for two and one experience (for example a tasting or a boat ride).
romanticni-pobeg.q3: When is the best time for a romantic visit to {name}?
romanticni-pobeg.a3: Spring (April–June) and early autumn (September–October) bring the most romantic atmosphere to {name} — pleasant temperatures, fewer tourists and beautiful colours in nature.
romanticni-pobeg.q4: Which places to stay in {name} are the most romantic?
romanticni-pobeg.a4: For a romantic escape we recommend boutique hotels and rooms with a view. Browse our lists of local spots in {name} — every provider is hand-picked.

druzinski.q1: Is {name} suitable for a visit with children?
druzinski.a1: Yes — {name} is an excellent family destination with safe walking trails, child-friendly restaurants and interactive experiences. Most attractions are accessible with pushchairs too.
druzinski.q2: How much does a family trip to {name} cost?
druzinski.a2: A family trip to {name} (2 adults + 2 children) usually costs {price}, including a family room, meals and attraction tickets. Children under 6 often enter free of charge.
druzinski.q3: Which activities in {name} are suitable for children?
druzinski.a3: {name} offers a variety of family activities — from easier walks and cycling to museums with interactive exhibitions, workshops and tastings. Our AI recommendations take the age of the children into account.
druzinski.q4: When is the best time for a family visit to {name}?
druzinski.a4: School holidays (summer, October, February) are ideal for a family visit to {name}. In summer all the outdoor attractions are open, while winter brings skiing and winter festivals.

budget.q1: How much does a visit to {name} cost on a budget?
budget.a1: On a limited budget you can visit {name} for {price}, including a bed in a hostel or private room, local food from the markets and free activities.
budget.q2: Which free activities are available in {name}?
budget.a2: {name} offers plenty of free activities — strolls through the old town, visits to churches, walking trails in the surroundings and public beaches. Museum tickets often carry student discounts.
budget.q3: How can I save on transport to {name}?
budget.a3: For affordable travel to {name} we recommend the train or bus (search via FlixBus or Slovenian Railways). In {name} you can use local public transport or a bike (many destinations have bike-share schemes).
budget.q4: Can I find cheap accommodation in {name}?
budget.a4: Yes — {name} has hostels, private rooms via Airbnb and family guesthouses. Prices are lower out of season (November–March, apart from holidays).

vikend.q1: What to do in {name} over a weekend?
vikend.a1: A weekend in {name} leaves room for the main sights, local cuisine and at least one experience. Friday evening is ideal for arriving and a stroll, Saturday for the headline attractions, Sunday for unwinding.
vikend.q2: How much does a weekend in {name} cost?
vikend.a2: A weekend in {name} (2 nights, 3 meals a day, attractions) costs roughly {price}. You can save with early-bird bookings and by shopping at local markets.
vikend.q3: When is the best time for a weekend escape to {name}?
vikend.a3: {name} works for a weekend escape all year round. Spring and autumn offer the best weather for exploring, summer brings more events, and winter means fewer tourists and lower prices.
vikend.q4: How do I get to {name} for a weekend?
vikend.a4: {name} is reachable by car, train or bus. We recommend booking transport at least a week in advance, especially for Friday afternoon.

ai.q: Can the AI put together an itinerary for {name}?
ai.a: Yes — our AI planner can build a fully tailored itinerary for {name} that reflects your interests, budget and available time. Give it a try on the Plan page.

s1.title: 1. General
s1.body: Discover Slovenia AI (the "platform") respects your privacy. This policy describes what data we collect, how we use it and what rights you have.

s2.title: 2. Visitor data
s2.body: We do not collect visitors' personal data without explicit consent. We only track anonymous analytics (page views, clicks) to improve the platform.

s3.title: 3. Newsletter
s3.body: If you subscribe to the newsletter, we store your email address. We use it solely to send you travel guides and tips. You can unsubscribe at any time.

s4.title: 4. Providers (B2B)
s4.body: Registered providers supply their name, email, company name and password. Passwords are stored with bcrypt hashing (12 rounds). Business details (address, phone, website) are publicly displayed on the platform.

s5.title: 5. Leads (JoinUs form)
s5.body: When you fill in the "Join us" form, we store: name, email, phone, company name, type, town and preferred plan. We use this data solely to contact you about your enquiry.

s6.title: 6. Cookies
s6.body: The platform uses strictly necessary cookies to function (authentication, language preferences). We do not use marketing or tracking cookies.

s7.title: 7. Payments (Stripe)
s7.body: Payments are processed by Stripe. We never store credit card details. Stripe is PCI-DSS certified.

s8.title: 8. Your rights
s8.body: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectification, erasure and portability of your data. To exercise your rights, write to <email>privacy@discoverslovenia.ai</email>.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
s1.body: By using the Discover Slovenia AI platform you accept these terms of use.

s2.title: 2. The service
s2.body: The platform provides information about Slovenian tourist destinations, AI travel planning and links to local providers. The platform does not handle bookings — users book directly with the providers.

s3.title: 3. AI itineraries
s3.body: AI-generated itineraries are for information only. The platform accepts no liability for the accuracy of prices, availability or the quality of third-party services.

s4.title: 4. Affiliate links
s4.body: The platform contains affiliate links (Booking.com, DiscoverCars, GetYourGuide, Skyscanner, World Nomads, SafetyWing, Airalo, Kiwitaxi, Omio, Tiqets and Viator). If you make a booking through one of these links, Discover Slovenia may receive an affiliate commission. The price you pay never goes up because of it; you complete the booking and any payment directly with the partner, whose terms apply.

s5.title: 5. Providers (B2B)
s5.body: Registered providers are responsible for the accuracy of their details. The flat subscription (Premium €149/month, Enterprise €499/month) is billed monthly. You can cancel at any time with 30 days' notice.

s6.title: 6. Beta period
s6.body: During the beta period (up to 30 active venues) all plans are free. Once monetisation is switched on, beta users keep 6 months of free access.

s7.title: 7. Intellectual property
s7.body: The platform's content is released under the MIT licence. Destination images come from open sources (Unsplash, OpenStreetMap). The website code is open source on GitHub.

s8.title: 8. Limitation of liability
s8.body: The platform accepts no liability for any damage arising from the use of information or links to third parties.

s9.title: 9. Changes to the terms
s9.body: These terms may be updated. We will notify registered users by email about important changes.

hero.title: Trust and safety
hero.subtitle: How we verify partners, how AI ranking works and how we protect your data.

adminApproval.title: Admin approval
adminApproval.body: Every venue must be manually approved by our team before it goes live. We check: correct contact details, category fit, and the quality of photos and descriptions. Unapproved venues are invisible to users and the AI cannot recommend them.

qualityScore.title: Partner Quality Score (0-100)
qualityScore.body: Every venue gets an automatically calculated Quality Score from 7 signals: profile completeness (30%), photo quality (15%), description quality (15%), AI tags (10%), admin verification (10%), ratings (10%) and data freshness (10%).

vlm.title: VLM image review
vlm.body: Every image on the platform is checked with a Vision Language Model (VLM). We verify: match with the venue's name, absence of watermarks, and the quality and appropriateness of the content.

ranking.title: How AI ranking works
ranking.intro: AI recommendations rest on 5 dimensions with clearly defined weights. Money cannot buy the top spot.

dimensions.relevance: Match with the user's search (destination, interests, category)
dimensions.distance: Geographic proximity to other stops in the itinerary
dimensions.premiumBoost: A maximum 5% boost for paying partners — it can never outweigh relevance

ranking.warningTitle: Our rule: the AI never recommends a poor venue just because it pays
ranking.warningText: Venues rated below 3.5 get no premium boost. Relevance (60%) always dominates over Premium (5%).

transparency.title: Recommendation transparency
transparency.intro: Every AI recommendation is clearly labelled. Users always know what is an advertisement and what is organic.

method.title: How we count (honestly)

comparison.title: Which AI trip planner is right for Slovenia?
comparison.intro: This is not a marketing brochure. Our editorial principle is honesty — so we admit where general planners beat us, and show where a Slovenia specialist gives you more. The decision is yours.
comparison.updated: Updated: 17 September 2026. Comparisons age — check the date before deciding.
comparison.generalistsTitle: What general AI planners do well
comparison.generalistsIntro: Mindtrip, Layla, Wanderlog, ChatGPT and peers are good products. For these cases, they are the right choice:

generalists.coverageDesc: Tokyo, Lisbon and Patagonia in the same chat. We cover Slovenia only.
generalists.bookingDesc: Integrations with major booking systems worldwide. With us you book local experiences and products, not flights.
generalists.collabDesc: Real-time collaboration with family or friends. We offer itinerary sharing with polls, not collaborative editing.
generalists.scaleDesc: Millions of users and large review bases. We are a young platform with a narrow but deep focus.

comparison.problemsTitle: Where generalists disappoint on Slovenia trips
comparison.problemsIntro: These are not invented pitfalls — they are documented in AI planner reviews (2025–2026) and in our own testing:

problems.priceDesc: Mindtrip reviewers report price deviations of 20–30 %. For a city break that is an annoyance; for a €300 weekend budget it is the difference between two days.
problems.closedDesc: The classic trap: the AI includes an attraction on a day it is closed (the famous “Louvre is closed on Tuesdays”). Without checking opening hours, it cannot know.
problems.genericDesc: The same list for everyone. Slovenia is small, but local depth — when Vintgar Gorge has no queue, where the authentic kremšnita is — requires specialized, curated data.

practice.ex2Desc: Time estimates “from the model's memory” can be off. Our stop-to-stop connectors carry actual kilometres and minutes from real-road routing — including winter sections.
practice.ex3Title: What will the day really cost?
practice.ex3Desc: Ticket and local-specialty prices come from a curated dataset with sources — the sum on a day card means something. When data is missing, we say so and add a warning.

comparison.notForYouTitle: When Discover Slovenia AI is NOT right for you
comparison.notForYouBody: If you are planning a cross-border trip, need flights or a hotel abroad — pick a generalist (Layla, Wanderlog, or a ChatGPT/Gemini chat). That is fine; we use them for our own foreign trips too. We would love to see you on the Slovenian leg.
comparison.ctaBody: From question to itinerary: 30 seconds. Required account: none. Language: Slovenian or English.

faq.q1: Do I need an account to plan a trip?
faq.a1: No. You create, save and share itineraries entirely without signing up — it works anonymously. A free account is optional and only adds trip history under My trips.
faq.a2: The planner, itineraries, guides and sharing are free. The platform earns from local experience bookings and marketplace sales — not from your data.
faq.q3: What if I am travelling outside Slovenia?
faq.a3: Honestly: for cross-border trips use a generalist (for example Layla, Wanderlog, Mindtrip) or an AI chat. We cover Slovenia only — but we cover it deeply, with verified local data.
faq.a4: Destination data is editorially curated, prices and opening hours carry sources, and every itinerary goes through geo-validation with warnings. When we are not sure, it says “verify before visiting”. The methodology is public on the Data sources page.
faq.q5: I have been using Mindtrip — why switch?
faq.a5: Mindtrip is a good generalist; their iOS app remains available, though their website was unreachable as of September 2026 when this was written. For Slovenia trips you get here: planning without an account, Slovenian as a core language, verified local data, and bookings with local providers. Judge for yourself — a no-signup try takes 30 seconds.
